title: ship_visibility config key surfaced in status + preamble (spec #81 P1)
action: In packages/bee/bee.mjs (source of truth; .bee/bin is the vendored copy regenerated by onboarding): (1) read `ship_visibility` from .bee/config.json — allowed values 'off' (default when absent) and 'draft-pr'; an unrecognized value normalizes to 'off' with a one-line stderr warning, never a crash. (2) Add `ship_visibility` field to the `status --json` payload. (3) In the session-preamble renderer (the module that renders the status preamble; locate via rg 'GATE BYPASS' packages/bee), when the value is 'draft-pr' add one line: 'Ship visibility: draft-pr — first cap opens a draft PR, every cap pushes (routing-and-contracts "Ship visibility")'. When 'off', render nothing (zero preamble cost). (4) REGEN OBLIGATION in-cell: node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply (syncs vendored .bee/bin), node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write; verify with --check. NO other behavior: PR creation/push remain orchestrator prose per routing-and-contracts (already written).

truths: status --json carries ship_visibility ('off' by default with no config key present).
Setting ship_visibility:'draft-pr' in .bee/config.json surfaces the field and the one preamble line; removing it reverts to 'off' silently.
Unrecognized value -> 'off' + stderr warning, exit unchanged.
onboard --apply + release_manifest --check green; vendored .bee/bin/bee.mjs matches source.
prohibitions: Do NOT implement git push / PR creation in code — prose-driven orchestrator behavior.
Do NOT change any other status field or preamble line.

trace.outcome: ship_visibility config key (off default, draft-pr recognized, unrecognized->off+stderr warn) surfaced in status --json and the session preamble (one line, draft-pr only); regen (onboard --apply, release_manifest --write/--check) and impacted tests green.
